acceptanceCriteria: release-gates.yml uses the same pinned ripgrep version and checksum.
body: Found 2026-10-10 in the CI critical-path lane (V1-1095). ci.yml and pr-tests-qualification.yml now install ripgrep 15.2.0 from a sha256-pinned release tarball; release-gates.yml still uses apt, so release hosts can resolve a different rg version than CI.
title: ci: release-gates.yml still installs ripgrep from apt instead of the pinned release binary
